solutions.explanation:
The condition \(x^2\ne1\) means \(x\ne1\) and \(x\ne-1\). Consequently, both \(f(x)\) and \(f(-x)\) are defined, and \(f(x)\ne0\). Replace every occurrence of the input by \(-x\), then multiply the numerator and denominator by \(-1\):
\[
f(-x)=\frac{-x+1}{-x-1}=\frac{x-1}{x+1}.
\]
This fraction is the reciprocal of \(f(x)=\frac{x+1}{x-1}\). Therefore
\[
f(-x)=\boxed{\frac1{f(x)}},
\]
choice A.
